description: Get the Gmail profile of the authenticated user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the profile object (emailAddress, messagesTotal, threadsTotal, historyId).

description: List all labels in the mailbox.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'labels' list of label objects (id, name, type).

description: Get a single label by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the label object; on failure (label not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new user label with the given name.

name.description: The name of the label to create.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created label object; on failure (label already exists), output contains an error message.

description: List messages, optionally filtered by a Gmail search query, label ids, and a max result count.

query.description: Optional Gmail-style search query (supports from:, to:, subject:, label:, is:unread, is:starred and free text).

max_results.description: Maximum number of message ids to return (default 25).

label_ids.description: Optional list of label ids; only messages carrying all of them are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'messages' list (id, threadId) and 'resultSizeEstimate'.

description: Get a single message by its id, in the requested format.

fmt.description: Format of the message; 'full' includes the payload/headers/body, otherwise only metadata is returned (default 'full').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized message; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

subject.description: The subject line of the message.

body.description: The plain-text body of the message.

thread_id.description: Optional thread id to attach the message to an existing thread.

from_addr.description: Optional sender address; defaults to the profile email address.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized sent message.

description: Add and/or remove labels on an existing message.

message_id.description: The id of the message to modify.

add_labels.description: Optional list of label ids to add.

remove_labels.description: Optional list of label ids to remove.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated serialized message; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Move a message to trash (adds TRASH label, removes INBOX).

message_id.description: The id of the message to trash.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated serialized message; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Permanently delete a message by its id.

message_id.description: The id of the message to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {deleted: true, id}; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: List threads, optionally filtered by a Gmail search query.

query.description: Optional Gmail-style search query applied to the underlying messages.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'threads' list and 'resultSizeEstimate'.

description: Get a thread and all of its messages by thread id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the thread object with its messages; on failure (thread not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all drafts in the mailbox.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'drafts' list.

description: Get a single draft by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the draft object; on failure (draft not found), output contains an error message.

subject.description: The subject line of the draft.

body.description: The plain-text body of the draft.

thread_id.description: Optional thread id the draft belongs to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created draft object.

description: Send an existing draft by its id, removing it from the drafts list.

draft_id.description: The id of the draft to send.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized sent message; on failure (draft not found), output contains an error message.
